A '''starship''' was manned by [[Droid/Legends|droid]] historians, led by a droid named [[NL0-A]], who were devoted to recording [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic events]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the ship returned from unknown space.<ref name="The Memory Machines">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Archaeology|The Memory Machines}}</ref>
